component.name: Clock
component.summary: Alarms, timers, a stopwatch and a world clock

description.p: Alarms that repeat on the days you choose, with a label, a sound and snooze; several timers at once, started from presets or your own length; a stopwatch with laps; and the time in cities around the world.
Alarms and timers ring with a notification and sound even when Clock's window is closed, and the Clock menu in the menu bar shows the running timers and the next alarm.
